assets.prompt: Create one isolated TRANSPARENT game inventory-slot STATE OVERLAY, ID slot-selected (never render the ID). Reference is the existing empty slot shape ONLY. Draw only its outline geometry as two thin concentric pixel lines, clearly selected, colored golden yellow #F5C65B with pale cream top-left edge, tiny dark pixel edging. IMPORTANT: REMOVE the entire navy center, so both the entire inside and outside of the square border are TRUE alpha transparent. This is a hollow square frame with stepped clipped corners, not a filled panel. No fill whatsoever, no shadow, no glow, no background/checkerboard paint. No icon, text, numbers, lock, ticks or objects. Style crisp 16-bit pixel art, flat colors. Symmetric square, equal border width, occupies 80 percent of a square canvas with uniform 10 percent outer transparent margins. Border about 3 percent of square width, corners step inward by 8 percent. Overlay will be placed on top of existing icons and must not hide their center. One PNG asset, not an atlas.
